subject: Phased contracting & MAP: CureGene evaluation acceptance and order dependencies
body:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@curegene.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Rios <dana.rios@curegene.com>, Chris Bell <cbell@curegene.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP & sequencing questions for pilot purchase

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. CureGene is moving forward with a 3-month pilot for internal R&D embeddings and generation. Procurement/legal asked me to get a concrete sequencing plan so they can budget and coordinate with Legal/IT. High-level asks from our side:
- We need confirmation of the gating order (MSA first, DPA before production data, order form shows billing & term)
- Security artifacts: SOC 2 report + completed security checklist
- Acceptance criteria for the pilot (latency SLOs + sample prompt set)

Can your team share a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and who signs what? I can pull in our procurement rep if helpful.

Appreciate it,
Alex
Alex Wu
Head of Procurement, CureGene

--

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@curegene.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & sequencing questions for pilot purchase

Hi Alex — thanks, and glad the demo resonated.

High-level sequencing we recommend (and what typically closes fastest):
1) Commercial terms review (order form draft) + MSA signature (MSA establishes commercial relationship; order form attaches pricing/term)
2) DPA countersigned or appended to the MSA (we can do a DPA addendum to the MSA if that speeds legal review)
3) Security evidence exchange (SOC 2 + checklist) in parallel with legal review
4) Onboarding kickoff and pilot start once MSA + order form are signed and DPA in place for any production datasets

I attached a short MAP spreadsheet that maps owners, dates, and gating docs. Vanessa is adding the evaluation acceptance criteria and the sample prompt suite. Laura will coordinate DocuSign logistics and billing code details.

As for acceptance criteria, we propose: 95th percentile latency <= 350ms for 50 token responses, embeddings cosine similarity recall >= 0.82 on your benchmark set, and no critical security findings from the checklist. Happy to adjust.

I'll loop in Priyom for procurement coordination (he owns our order form templating).

Best,
Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, draft_order_form_202608.pdf

--

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@curegene.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Rios <dana.rios@curegene.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & sequencing questions for pilot purchase

Alex — quick note on the MAP and acceptance flow. I uploaded a draft MAP (see attachment) and added a simple three-phase acceptance plan:
Phase A (Eval): Sandbox access, run evaluation prompts (2 weeks) — acceptance = embedding recall and generation quality on agreed prompts.
Phase B (Pilot): MSA + Order Form signed, DPA in place for PII-level data, 3-month pilot with weekly quality checks.
Phase C (Scale): Post-pilot renewal or committed capacity (Dedicated) discussions.

Owners:
- Redwood legal: review MSA + DPA (Laura)
- CureGene legal: Dana
- Procurement: Alex (CureGene) and Priyom (Redwood)
- Security evidence: Chris Bell (CureGene) and Redwood security (we will share SOC 2 and completed checklist)

I added quick ETA's in the MAP spreadsheet — MSA turned around within 5 business days is realistic if both legal teams use the redline-to-accept approach. If CureGene needs a DPA redline earlier, we can exchange a DPA addendum now and attach it to the MSA later.

Vanessa
Sr. Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

--

From: Dana Rios <dana.rios@curegene.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Wu <alex.wu@curegene.com>, Chris Bell <cbell@curegene.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & sequencing questions for pilot purchase

Thanks Vanessa — a couple of clarifying items from CureGene Legal: 
1) We prefer to have the DPA reviewed in parallel but the MSA signed before any order form execution that permits production data ingress.
2) Please confirm whether Redwood will accept our standard security SLA language (we attached our baseline with the security checklist).
3) Need to confirm billing switching: will pilot invoices be net-30? We can share PO timing but need certainty for CFO.

Also, for the MAP, please call out explicit signatories and DocuSign order so our procurement team can coordinate availability.

Regards,
Dana Rios
Corporate Counsel, CureGene Therapeutics

Attachment referenced: CureGene_Security_Checklist_filled.pdf

--

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dana Rios <dana.rios@curegene.com>, Alex Wu <alex.wu@curegene.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & sequencing questions for pilot purchase

Dana/Alex — thanks for the specifics. Quick summary and proposed timeline so procurement/legal can block calendars: 
Action items & timeline (target dates assume a 5-business-day MSA review window):
- Today (Aug 29): Redwood sends final MSA draft + DPA addendum and the signed MAP workbook (we will push by EOD).
- Aug 30 - Sep 3: CureGene legal reviews MSA/DPA; Redwood legal will be on standby for redlines.
- Sep 4: Target MSA signature via DocuSign (MSA executed; DPA countersigned or committed to be appended).
- Sep 6: Execute order form and process PO for pilot (billing net-30 unless otherwise stated).
- Sep 7: Onboarding kickoff and sandbox access; eval window starts Sep 7 - Sep 21.
- Sep 22: Acceptance review call and decision on pilot extension/scale.

Notes:
- If CureGene requires DPA accepted prior to any sandbox data, we can expedite DPA review this week.
- Priyom will circulate the order form template with the PO/billing section and our standard net-30 payment terms; if CureGene needs different terms, flag immediately so we can route to finance.
- DocuSign sequence: MSA -> DPA addendum (if separate) -> Order Form (Order Form will reference executed MSA by UUID).

Next steps: Karthik/Vanessa/Priyom will upload the MSA+order form to DocuSign and share the link here; Alex/Dana/Chris please confirm availability the week of Aug 30 for a 30-minute redline alignment call.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments in thread: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, draft_order_form_202608.pdf, CureGene_Security_Checklist_filled.pdf
